title: AgriEdge: leakage audit tooling and a leakage-free precision-agriculture IIoT intrusion detection benchmark
description:
Software and result tables accompanying the paper Provenance, Not Behaviour: A Serialisation Artifact in Edge-IIoTset and a Leakage-Free Benchmark for Precision-Agriculture Intrusion Detection.

Edge-IIoTset is a widely used benchmark for machine-learning intrusion detection in the industrial IoT. This release documents and quantifies a serialisation artifact in its curated subsets: normal-traffic and attack captures were parsed separately, so the placeholder written for an absent protocol field is spelled 0 in one branch and 0.0 in the other. Four of the seven columns the distributed preprocessing recipe instructs researchers to one-hot encode therefore recover the attack/normal label with accuracy 1.0000 on their own, encoding file provenance rather than network behaviour. The leak is encoding-agnostic and separates every row of both curated subsets.

The repository contains: a reusable leakage audit library; a dependency-free verification script that reproduces the finding against any copy of the distributed CSVs; corrected benchmarks under a leakage-free protocol; AgriEdge, a precision-agriculture benchmark rebuilt from the raw per-device captures under uniform parsing (1,276,122 rows, five devices, full device attribution); a leave-one-device-out generalisation sweep; non-IID federated learning experiments; and edge deployment cost measurements.

All experiments are seeded and run on commodity hardware. The 37 MB rebuilt benchmark is regenerable in one command from the source dataset and is therefore not carried in the source archive.
